title: The Church in the Local Community

flashcard_questions.q: The community of Christians, both the physical building and the body of believers who gather to worship.
A charitable organisation that collects and distributes food to people who cannot afford to buy enough to eat.
Trained volunteers from local churches who patrol town and city centres at night, caring for vulnerable people.
Who founded the Street Pastors movement in London in 2003?
What is the name of Jesus's command to make disciples of all nations?
